findings.text: CRUX CLEAN (the judgment that matters). This is a textbook pure refactor of the core validator. Behavior preservation is not merely claimed, it is proven by construction (the moved bodies are byte-verbatim) AND empirically (25 CLI modes byte-identical stdout+rc over an identical tree, proof_digest recomputes to the exact recorded digest, run_all/main unchanged). GOVERNANCE GAP, honestly disclosed, non-blocking. The new module .warp/validate_checks.py resolves to NO declared contract area (the contracts area's includes are exact paths and list only .warp/validate.py), so the shape gate's area-based module_lines budget does NOT govern it: I confirmed a 1500-line copy of validate_checks.py yields an EMPTY shape-gate finding. Its size is instead held by the WARP-1012 selftest assertion (len(validate_checks.py) <= module_lines max), which is a real gate teeth via the unit lane - so the budget is effectively enforced, just through the selftest rather than the shape gate. The builder disclosed this exactly (proof assumptions[1], spec Out-of-scope: 'adding it to the human-approved contract is a separate governance act, not this refactor'). Recommendation for a human eye: when convenient, add '.warp/validate_checks.py' to the architecture contract's contracts-area includes so the gate's module_lines budget governs it directly, closing the gap the selftest currently backstops. Not blocking: the module is 360 lines with wide margin, the size teeth exists, and this is out of scope for a pure code-move.

COVERAGE RE-POINT is faithful (verified against the old text). I diffed the two changed WARP-1102 AC3 assertions: old asserted 'validate.py exceeds the file_lines budget (the grandfathering is real)' and 'the SAME real over-budget file WOULD be refused'; new assert 'validate.py is UNDER budget' and 'the restored validate.py yields NO module_lines finding'. The load-bearing teeth (a 1001-line contracts-area file refused naming module_lines) live in WARP-1102's seeded fixture, which this commit does NOT touch, and WARP-1012 adds its own over-budget-copy teeth. Coverage is preserved and arguably sharpened, not hollowed.
